answer: Publish a per-epoch similarity index: every answer is shingled into character n-grams and any pair scoring above a Jaccard threshold is flagged automatically. A standing bounty pays whoever first reports a colliding pair a slice of the smaller bond, so a farm's own clones are landmines. Renting a gale of fresh keys stays cheap, but each head must clear a glacier-slow originality bar - prose as distinct as neighboring yarrow stands - every epoch, so attacker cost scales with fleet size instead of amortizing.
